summary: Frontend-only regression after the raw -> wrapper migration (responsive srcSet + WebP/AVIF via /api/files?w=&fmt=auto and Unsplash/Pexels native resize). Verified across PUBLIC home (/), trip catalog landing (/viajes/surdemarruecos), an itinerary detail page (/viajes/atlas_desierto/programa_4n_5d) including DayImageGallery + TripPostcards stamps, and the ADMIN panel (/admin) on URLs, Galerías and Library tabs. Across every page visited and after scrolling to trigger lazy loads, ZERO broken images were observed (no img with complete && naturalWidth===0). On every page 100% of optimizable content imgs carried both a non-empty srcset and a width param (?w=) in src, while local logos/SVGs correctly pass through without srcset.
critical_code_review_comments: Img.jsx is clean (24-line wrapper); correctly forwards loading=lazy/eager, decoding=async, fetchpriority=high for priority, and only attaches sizes when srcset exists.
imageUrl.js#isOptimizable correctly excludes .svg, .gif and data: URIs so local logos (grup-xaluca-logo, monograma) are unaffected — confirmed in DOM (these imgs have no srcset and still display).
All sampled proxied content imgs are emitted as /api/files/...?w=<width>&fmt=auto with a full 320..1920 srcset, exactly matching the spec.
On the trip page 95/238 imgs remained `pending` after 20s of scrolling — this is the expected lazy behavior (well below the fold) and not a regression; none of them were broken.
Pre-existing console warning 'cdn.tailwindcss.com should not be used in production' still present (out of scope for this feature).
Pre-existing React duplicate-key warning in LibraryManager (iteration_45 RCA) NOT re-tested here — out of scope; still pending fix per previous report.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 0 broken images on every page visited

context_for_next_testing_agent: Image pipeline migration is verified working end-to-end. drop-in correctly applies srcSet + sizes + optimized src for /api/files, Unsplash and Pexels; local SVG/webp logos correctly bypass optimization. No broken images across home/catalog/itinerary/admin. The only outstanding (pre-existing, unrelated) issue is the duplicate-key warning in LibraryManager flagged in iteration_45.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions found from the migration.
